Sasha: Customer report: token delta spike when client reconnects during a streaming toolcall. Console shows provisional and confirmed tokens both present.
Ara: Any minimal repro?
Sasha: Yes — start stream, drop at chunk N, client resumes with new session id. Ledger ends up with provisional rows for old session and confirmed for new.
Sasha: Trace excerpt:
[router] accept S-100
[worker] emit chunk #24
[router] conn_lost S-100
[router] resume -> S-101 resume_from=25
[worker] EOF at 24 (truncation)
[ledger] provisional add S-100 tokens 1..24
[ledger] confirmed add S-101 tokens 25..80
Mike: Looks like router writes provisional capture for the suffix before worker tombstones S-100. Classic handoff race.
Jordan: Options: (A) delay provisional write until worker confirms EOF (adds small latency), (B) mark provisional as provisional and run reconciliation job to revoke overlaps, (C) require client idempotency on resume to dedupe.
Ara: Short-term we should surface provisional vs settled in the console and add a metric to quantify overlap.
Eva: UX: expose a per-route "provisional tokens" banner + tooltip linking to reconciliation details to cut down support churn.
Mike: I'll add a metric stub: stream_resume_overlap_count{route,cause} and resume_generation on capture writes.
LedgerBot: Ticket LEDGER-5701 created: reconcile-provisional-overlap-job
Sasha: Plan: short-term = telemetry + console flag + runbook; medium = reconciliation job; long-term = router change + SDK idempotency. I'll draft RFC and microbench latency numbers.
Jordan: I'll mock the dashboard tile. Ping when proto change lands.
Eva: I'll update runbook and compose customer-facing tooltip text.
Sasha: Thanks — sync tomorrow 11am PT to align on telemetry scope. :thumbsup:
